verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's JavaScript scenario feature lets a single API call click and fill form fields before the HTML is returned, so a login form can be submitted within one request. Custom cookies can carry an authenticated session forward, and session_id keeps the same IP across requests. However, nothing shows a persistent browser session that lets you keep interacting with a page you have already scraped; each call appears to be a fresh, pre-scripted run. Missing for 10: stateful continuation of an existing browser session across calls, documented login-wall walkthrough, independent hands-on corroboration.
